ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_RECORD_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_record_check IS
 counter NUMBER;
 chk NUMBER;
BEGIN
 if :global.public_epitope_id != :valid_hla_epitopes.public_epitope_id or
 :global.associated_epitope_id != :valid_hla_epitopes.associated_epitope_id then /* new check */
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C05C06',:global.public_epitope_id||
 ','||:global.associated_epitope_id||
 ',','D',chk); 
 end if;

 IF :global.public_epitope_id =:valid_hla_epitopes.public_epitope_id and
 :global.associated_epitope_id = :valid_hla_epitopes.associated_epitope_id 
 THEN
 null;
 ELSE
 if :valid_hla_epitopes.public_epitope_id is not null and
 :valid_hla_epitopes.associated_epitope_id is not null 
 then
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO counter
 FROM valid_hla_epitopes
 WHERE public_epitope_id = :valid_hla_epitopes.public_epitope_id and
 associated_epitope_id = :valid_hla_epitopes.associated_epitope_id;
 if :system.record_status = 'INSERT' then 
 if counter > 0 then 
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 else 
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C02C06',:valid_hla_epitopes.public_epitope_id||
 ','||:valid_hla_epitopes.associated_epitope_id||
 ',','U',chk); 
 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 END IF;
 end if;
 end if;

 if :system.record_status = 'CHANGED' then
 if counter > 1 then
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 else
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C02C06',:valid_hla_epitopes.public_epitope_id||
 ','||:valid_hla_epitopes.associated_epitope_id||
 ',','U',chk); 
 
 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 END IF;
 end if;
 end if; /* record status check end*/
 end if; /* not null if */
END IF; /* 1st if then */
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_EFF_TERM_DATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_eff_term_date (eff_date IN date, term_date IN date) IS
BEGIN
 if eff_date is not null then
 if term_date is not null then
 if term_date < trunc(sysdate) then
 show_error('3115'); --term date can not be less than sysdate
 end if;
 
 if eff_date > term_date then
 show_error('2314'); -- term date can not be less than eff date
 end if;
 end if;

 if eff_date < trunc(sysdate) then
 show_error('2312');
 end if;
 end if; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EFF_TERM_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_eff_term_dates ( eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2 ) 
IS
dt_chk boolean;
begin
 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 end if;
 if eff_date < trunc(sysdate) and from_where = 'E' then
 show_error('5015');
 end if;

 if term_date is not null then
 if term_date < trunc(sysdate) then
 show_error('3115');
 end if;
 dt_chk := check_from_to_date(eff_date,term_date);
 if dt_chk then
 null;
 else
 --message('Err. Term date is before effective date.');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('5004');
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_CONTROL_BLOCK_ITEMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE set_control_block_items(action IN varchar2) IS
 sState varchar2(10);
BEGIN
 if action = 'E' then -- If to be enabled
 sState := 'FALSE'; -- Check if disabled
 else -- If to be disabled
 sState := 'TRUE'; -- Check if enabled
 end if;
 if get_item_property( 'ctrl_block.public_epitope_id', enabled) = sState then
 item_change('ctrl_block.public_epitope_id',action);
 end if;
 if get_item_property( 'ctrl_block.pb_retrieve', enabled) = sState then
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve',action);
 end if;
 if get_item_property( 'ctrl_block.pb_public_epitope_id', enabled) = sState then
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_public_epitope_id',action);
 end if;
END;

end;
